title: Khaali Hai Maa ki Goud Ab Aao Ali Asghar
body:
Khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher, itna na apni maa ko satao Ali asgher
Ghar ja rahi hai maa chalo aao Ali asgher, dil ko na mere aur dukhao Ali asgher, Armaan khaak mein na milao Ali asgher, sunsaan zindagi na banao Ali asgher
Khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher
Paani na milsakega aye bachchey tujhe yahan, naizey tabar hain teer hain talwaar barchiyaan, tufaan zalzaley hain har ek simth aandhiyaan, deho to uthke kaisa larazta hai aasmaan, khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher
<<DIVIDER>>
Kurta lahoo se ho gaya kyon laal kuch kaho, maidan mein kistarah se larey haal kuch kaho , khoon mein yeh kaise tar huva roomal kuch kaho, kab se pukarti hoon mere laal kuch kaho, khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher
Taare nikal chuke hain chalo raat hogayi, jungle hai khaufnaak fiza mein hai tharthari, sunsaan kayenaath hai viraan zindagi, chayi huvi hai charoontaraf ek teeragi, khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher
Tum hi nahi ho jee nahi lagta mera kahin, ji kar bhala main kya karoon pehlo mein tum nahi, raoshan thi kayenath meri tumse naazneen, dekho tadap tadap ke na mar jaye maa kahin, khali hai maa ki goad ab aao Ali asgher..
